fields.missed_weight: lbs over the limit at the official weigh-in (0 = no miss reported on Wikipedia; null = no article, or a miss whose size the article does not give)
fields.missed: true if the Wikipedia event article reports the fighter missing weight
fields.weighed: reported scale weight for a miss (lbs) when the article gives it
fields.catchweight: is: booked at catchweight (ufcstats / Wikipedia weight class) or contested off-weight after a miss; lbs: agreed limit when stated; why: booked | weight miss
fields.short_notice: days of notice for a late replacement (who stepped in for a withdrawn fighter); null when not a replacement or when the article gives no date
fields.replacement: true if the fighter replaced a withdrawn fighter (not booked in this pairing originally)
fields.opp_change: the fighter's booked opponent was replaced: days before the event when the new opponent was set (-1 = changed, date unknown); null = no change found
fields.home: fighter's primary nationality (see fighters[slug]) equals the venue country
fields.home_any: venue country is any of the fighter's countries (sport country, citizenships, birth country, Sherdog nationality)
fields.tz_shift_h: hours between the venue's UTC offset and the fighter's home point (birthplace if in his primary country, else the country's reference city) on the event date, wrapped to <= 12
fields.travel_km: great-circle km from that home point to the venue city
fields.no_crowd: event held behind closed doors (COVID-19 period)
fields.event_type: numbered_ppv (UFC ### through 2025) | numbered (2026+, no PPV) | fight_night | tuf_finale
fields.card_segment: Wikipedia results-table heading (main card / preliminary card ...)

meta.walk_forward: all fields are known before the fight; nationality and home point are a current snapshot
